label: users_any_with_name
sql:
Executed DbCommand (0ms) [Parameters=[@cleanedUsername='?' (Size = 3)], CommandType='Text', CommandTimeout='30']
      SELECT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM "Users" AS "u"
          WHERE "u"."Name" = @cleanedUsername)

label: users_first_by_name_and_password
sql:
Executed DbCommand (0ms) [Parameters=[@cleanedUsername='?' (Size = 3), @hashedPassword='?' (Size = 1)], CommandType='Text', CommandTimeout='30']
      SELECT "u"."Id", "u"."Email", "u"."HashedPassword", "u"."LastLogin", "u"."Name", "u"."PasswordResetToken", "u"."PasswordResetTokenCreated", "u"."PlayerName"
      FROM "Users" AS "u"
      WHERE "u"."Name" = @cleanedUsername AND "u"."HashedPassword" = @hashedPassword
      LIMIT 1

label: users_first_for_login
sql:
Executed DbCommand (0ms) [Parameters=[@ToLower='?' (Size = 3), @hashedPassword='?' (Size = 1)], CommandType='Text', CommandTimeout='30']

      FROM "Users" AS "u"

      LIMIT 1
